notes: Eight compact, valid schema_version 2.1 findings, each isolating one policy-classification scenario from examples/ACCESSIBILITY_FINDING_TRACKING.md's 'Policy Classification' section.

These are illustrative fragments focused on the policy object; unrelated fields are minimal but schema-valid. They are not run through the fingerprint cross-check in validate-accessibility-findings.mjs because none of them carry tracking.fingerprints -- policy classification never depends on, and never alters, fingerprint identity.
validate-accessibility-findings.mjs validates every case in this file against the schema and fails if any is invalid.

finding.title: Nav menu: expanded/collapsed state not exposed to assistive technology

description.summary: The primary navigation toggle does not expose aria-expanded, so screen reader users cannot tell whether the menu is open.

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Project baseline target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

finding.title: Automated scan: possible color-contrast failure on pricing table

description.summary: axe-core reported a color-contrast violation; not yet reproduced or reviewed by a human.

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Project baseline target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

policy.handling_basis: Automated indicator only; not yet confirmed by a human reviewer.

cases.description: Confirmed AAA finding under an AA target: aspirational + report.

finding.title: Help content: no sign language interpretation provided for instructional video

description.summary: The instructional video has captions but no sign language interpretation track.

affected_people.description: Deaf people who use sign language as a primary language

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Project baseline target is WCAG 2.2 AA; AAA criteria are stretch goals by default and this one has not been elevated to required.

policy.handling_basis: Confirmed and visible as a stretch-goal opportunity; non-blocking for the AA baseline.

finding.title: Automated scan: possible enhanced-contrast (AAA) shortfall on marketing banner

description.summary: A rule flagged text that may fall short of the AAA 7:1 contrast ratio; not yet reviewed.

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Project baseline target is WCAG 2.2 AA; AAA criteria are stretch goals by default.

policy.handling_basis: Automated indicator only; unresolved and not yet human-reviewed.

cases.description: Best-practice rule outside the standards target: advisory.

finding.title: Form field: placeholder text disappears with no persistent label hint

description.summary: A recognized usability best practice recommends persistent hint text, but this is not part of the project's WCAG target or a declared stretch goal.

affected_people.description: People with cognitive or memory-related disabilities

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Recognized best practice; not part of the WCAG 2.2 AA baseline or a declared stretch goal.

cases.description: AAA criterion elevated by local policy: required.

finding.title: Emergency alert banner: no low-frequency audio alternative provided

description.summary: The emergency alert banner lacks an alternative for a specific AAA criterion the project has elevated to required for safety-critical content.

affected_people.description: People who are deaf or hard of hearing

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Local policy: elevated to required for safety-critical emergency-alert content, per project accessibility policy section 4.2 (2026-03-01).

finding.title: Automated scan: reported missing alt text on a decorative background image

description.summary: The tool flagged a missing alt attribute; a reviewer confirmed the image is purely decorative and correctly implemented with an empty alt and aria-hidden.

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Reviewed: image is decorative and correctly hidden from assistive technology.

policy.handling_basis: Confirmed false positive; excluded from active reporting but retained for audit history.

suppression.scope: Automated rule reporting for this element only
suppression.reason: Element is a decorative background image with empty alt and aria-hidden="true"; the rule cannot detect decorative intent.
suppression.evidence_basis: Manual review of the rendered DOM confirmed aria-hidden and empty alt were present and correctly applied.

finding.title: Third-party checkout widget: focus order issue pending vendor fix

description.summary: A confirmed focus-order barrier exists in a third-party embedded widget; a vendor fix is scheduled, and the finding is temporarily suppressed from the merge-blocking CI gate while the fix is pending.

standards_obligations.obligation_basis: Project baseline target: WCAG 2.2 Level AA.

policy.handling_basis: Confirmed defect in third-party code with a scheduled vendor fix; suppressed from the CI merge gate only, not from the tracked backlog.

suppression.scope: CI merge-blocking gate for the checkout route only
suppression.reason: Root cause is in a third-party widget outside this team's codebase; a vendor fix is scheduled and blocking merges would stop unrelated work.
suppression.evidence_basis: Vendor support ticket VEND-4821 confirms the defect and a target fix date.
